packageRules.description: Automerge GitHub Actions minor, patch, and digest updates
Manual review for GitHub Actions major updates
Automerge pre-commit hooks minor and patch updates
Manual review for pre-commit hooks major updates
Automerge npm devDependency minor and patch updates, labeled release:none since these repos' package.json devDependencies are always semantic-release tooling, never a shipped runtime artifact

Manual review for npm devDependency major updates - still release:none for the same reason as the minor/patch rule above; unlabeled would otherwise force a manual label just to unblock Release Label Check on a PR that's correctly held for real reasons (e.g. a toolchain incompatibility caught by verify-release-notes)
Automerge pip requirements minor and patch updates
Manual review for pip requirements major updates
Automerge Gradle wrapper minor and patch updates - it's build tooling, not a runtime dependency, so it never changes the compiled jar and doesn't warrant a release
Manual review for Gradle wrapper major updates (build compatibility risk), still release:none for the same reason as above
Automerge Gradle/Maven dependency patch updates (e.g. junit-bom) and label them release:patch so the Release Label Check passes without manual intervention
Automerge Gradle/Maven dependency minor updates, labeled release:minor for the same reason as the patch rule above
Manual review for Gradle/Maven dependency major updates - left unlabeled so a human picks the release type

Test-only frameworks (JUnit, Mockito) are always testImplementation/testRuntimeOnly scoped - never bundled into the compiled jar - so label them release:none instead of the release:patch/minor the general Gradle/Maven rule above would apply. Renovate's gradle manager can't expose depType for matchDepTypes here (issue renovatebot/renovate#27777), so this is scoped by package name to well-known test-only groupIds rather than by dep type. Overrides the general rule for all update types, including major, since a JUnit/Mockito major bump still never touches the shipped artifact.
Automerge Go module patch updates and label them release:patch so the Release Label Check passes without manual intervention
Automerge Go module minor updates, labeled release:minor for the same reason as the patch rule above
Manual review for Go module major updates - left unlabeled so a human picks the release type

Automerge Dockerfile/Containerfile base image digest and patch updates (native docker manager - FROM lines not covered by a custom regex ARG manager) and label them release:patch, since a new base image is a real deploy-affecting change
Automerge Dockerfile/Containerfile base image minor updates, labeled release:minor for the same reason as the patch/digest rule above
Manual review for Dockerfile/Containerfile base image major updates - left unlabeled so a human picks the release type
Automerge PEP 621 (pyproject.toml) dependency patch updates and label them release:patch so the Release Label Check passes without manual intervention
Automerge PEP 621 (pyproject.toml) dependency minor updates, labeled release:minor for the same reason as the patch rule above
Manual review for PEP 621 (pyproject.toml) dependency major updates - left unlabeled so a human picks the release type

PEP 735 dependency-groups (e.g. dependency-groups.dev - pytest, ruff, etc.) are dev/test tooling never shipped in the built artifact, so label them release:none instead of the release:patch/minor the general PEP 621 rule above would apply. Overrides the general rule for all update types, including major, since CI (the test suite) is what actually needs to pass here, not a release.

Automerge regex/custom-regex tracked deps patch updates (e.g. anthropic/PyYAML pinned via *_VERSION-style vars, Dockerfile ARG version pins, own-repo github-releases) and label them release:patch so the Release Label Check required by container repos passes without manual intervention
Automerge regex/custom-regex tracked deps minor updates, labeled release:minor for the same reason as the patch rule above
Manual review for regex/custom-regex tracked deps major updates - left unlabeled so a human picks the release type
